product_overview: AqiqahOn is a web-based business management system for Sahabat Aqiqah that helps staff manage operational dashboards, schedules, reminders, and master data. The app supports authenticated internal workflows for tracking orders and maintaining core reference data.
core_goals: Let users sign in and access the operational dashboard
Let users monitor order and schedule status across daily operations
Let users review calendar-based schedule visibility and reminders
Let users manage goat type master data through CRUD actions

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with user ID and password to enter the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /login/ -> Fill in user ID -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login/ -> Fill in incorrect user ID or password -> Submit the login form -> See an invalid credentials message

features.name: Dashboard View
features.description: Review the main operational dashboard after signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to / after login -> View today's orders summary -> View counts for unscheduled, cooking, packing, ready, on delivery, and completed orders -> View sidebar notification badge

features.name: Reminder System
features.description: Check operational reminders for schedules that need attention.
user_flows: Navigate to /jadwal/reminders/ -> View overdue schedule reminders -> View missing driver assignments -> View incomplete packing reminders -> Select a reminder to open the related schedule

features.name: Order Schedule List
features.description: Browse and manage the daily order schedule list with filtering and status updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /jadwal/ -> View the default schedule list for today -> Search for a schedule by keyword -> Filter schedules by delivery date, event date, customer name, driver, status, region, branch, or goat type -> Select a schedule row to view details -> Update the schedule status or assign a driver -> Save the schedule update
Navigate to /jadwal/ -> View the schedule table -> Filter by a value that matches no records -> See an empty result list

features.name: Schedule Calendar View
features.description: View orders and schedules in a calendar format.
user_flows: Navigate to /jadwal/events/ -> View schedules displayed on a calendar -> Move to another month -> Select a calendar event to open its details

features.name: Goat Type Master CRUD
features.description: Create, review, update, and delete goat type master records.
user_flows: Navigate to /master/goat-type/ -> View the list of goat types -> Open the add form -> Fill in goat type code, name, display order, and active status -> Save the new goat type -> Return to the list and see the new record
Navigate to /master/goat-type/ -> Select a goat type row -> Open the detail view -> Return to the list
Navigate to /master/goat-type/ -> Select a goat type row -> Open the edit form -> Change the goat type name or display order -> Save the update -> Return to the list and see the changed record
Navigate to /master/goat-type/ -> Select a goat type row -> Open the delete flow -> Confirm deletion -> Return to the list and see the record removed
